picks.title: EP: 468 The Church is Afraid of the Supernatural with Jon Moffitt
picks.summary:

It is not that the Reformed church calls it heresy. It is that the Reformed church is so afraid of looking charismatic that it simply goes quiet. Jon lives in that silence for years, until he sits down to preach the Lord's Prayer and gets stuck on one line. Deliver us from the evil one. He realizes he has never heard a single sermon on it, and pulling that thread unravels everything he thought he was allowed to say.

picks.reason: Addresses spiritual warfare and the church's silence on supernatural realities.

picks.title: Saturated Sunday: Two Options - Religion to Redemption - Matthew S6E7
picks.summary:
In Matthew 26, we see two very different responses to Jesus. 
Mary pours out what is most valuable to her in extravagant worship, while Judas chooses his own way when Jesus does not give him what he wants.
Religion asks what we can get from Jesus. Redemption recognizes what Jesus has already done for us and responds by surrendering everything to Him. There is no middle ground. 
We can live life our own way, or we can fall at the feet of Jesus and pour out our lives for the One who poured out His life for us.

picks.reason: Contrasts religion and redemption through Jesus with biblical examples from Matthew.
